---
description: "Consumer documentation structure and evidence-aware writing rules"
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md, README.md, **/agent-output/**/*.md"
---

# APEX Consumer Documentation

- Use one H1 per document and concise H2 sections for the remaining structure.
- Keep lines within 120 characters and use fenced code blocks with a language.
- Link to local, consumer-relevant files with descriptive text.
- Distinguish implemented behavior from deferred or unqualified capabilities.
- Do not claim deployment, client, provider, or compliance qualification without recorded evidence.
